tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards on every hub screen. Never behind text smaller than 12px except ink, ink-2 and ink-3.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar, the player hero and the newsletter page. The only ground a headshot may sit on.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Tiles nested inside a card (lines tiles, newsletter at-a-glance tiles), table header rows, chart figures in the newsletter.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control and Simple/Detailed track on white; neutral chip fill (IL, Neutral).

tokens.name: row-inactive
tokens.usage: Rows that don't count right now: IL slots in the roster table.

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: Emphasis only: the app header, the newsletter masthead, the active Simple/Detailed pill. Never behind a headshot.

tokens.name: dark-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons and contents chips on dark.

tokens.name: dark-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and control borders on dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, table header rules, segmented track on canvas. Decorative separation only.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside cards; chart gridlines.

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: Chart baselines (the zero line) and headshot placeholder fill.

tokens.name: axis-strong
tokens.usage: Reference lines that carry meaning (the 50% line, the average line on light charts) and de-emphasised marks that still carry a value. 3.27:1 on surface.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of percentile bars, keep-chance bars and progress tracks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on surface, surface-subtle, canvas (17:1+).

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Active tab label, sorted column header, pull-quote text and rule, average line on bar charts.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Newsletter prose (17px reading text) on surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: eyebrow section titles, meta lines, explanations. 6.6:1+ on every light ground.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: KPI labels, sub-lines, axis labels, footnotes. 5.0:1 on surface-sunken, 5.2:1 on canvas. Replaces the mockups' #64748B, which failed on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Primary text on dark and dark-raised.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on dark: the date line, the dek, back links.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow text on dark (issue line in the masthead). 7:1 on dark. Never on light grounds (2.6:1).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The freshness dot on dark when data is fresh. Always beside the words 'Updated N min ago'.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interaction colour: links, 'Details ›', back links, focus ring on light grounds. 10:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed and visited state of accent links.

tokens.name: focus-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus ring on dark grounds (9.9:1 on dark).

tokens.name: team-blue
tokens.usage: Team slot 1. A manager's colour for every mark that means this team: lines, bars, monograms, swatches, win %. 4.9:1+ on surface, so it may also be text (team names, win %). White text on it: 4.9:1+.

tokens.name: team-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind this team's chip and the winner's row tint in the newsletter. Text on it uses team-blue-ink.

tokens.name: team-blue-ink
tokens.usage: Text on team-blue-tint (team chip label). 6.8:1+.

tokens.name: team-orange
tokens.usage: Team slot 2. A manager's colour for every mark that means this team: lines, bars, monograms, swatches, win %. 4.9:1+ on surface, so it may also be text (team names, win %). White text on it: 4.9:1+.

tokens.name: team-orange-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind this team's chip and the winner's row tint in the newsletter. Text on it uses team-orange-ink.

tokens.name: team-orange-ink
tokens.usage: Text on team-orange-tint (team chip label). 6.8:1+.

tokens.name: team-teal
tokens.usage: Team slot 3. A manager's colour for every mark that means this team: lines, bars, monograms, swatches, win %. 4.9:1+ on surface, so it may also be text (team names, win %). White text on it: 4.9:1+.

tokens.name: team-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind this team's chip and the winner's row tint in the newsletter. Text on it uses team-teal-ink.

tokens.name: team-teal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on team-teal-tint (team chip label). 6.8:1+.

tokens.name: team-plum
tokens.usage: Team slot 4. A manager's colour for every mark that means this team: lines, bars, monograms, swatches, win %. 4.9:1+ on surface, so it may also be text (team names, win %). White text on it: 4.9:1+.

tokens.name: team-plum-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind this team's chip and the winner's row tint in the newsletter. Text on it uses team-plum-ink.

tokens.name: team-plum-ink
tokens.usage: Text on team-plum-tint (team chip label). 6.8:1+.

tokens.name: status-out
tokens.usage: 'Out' chip text, and only that. Always with the word.

tokens.name: status-out-tint
tokens.usage: 'Out' chip fill.

tokens.name: status-q
tokens.usage: 'Q' (questionable / game-time decision) chip text.

tokens.name: status-q-tint
tokens.usage: 'Q' chip fill.

tokens.name: status-il
tokens.usage: 'IL' chip text. IL is a roster state, not alarm: neutral.

tokens.name: status-il-tint
tokens.usage: 'IL' chip fill.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Positive change: ▲ deltas, 'Healthy'. Always with ▲ or a + sign, never colour alone. 5.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Negative change: ▼ deltas; the event marker on the win-chance line. Always with ▼ or a − sign. 6.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: grade-a
tokens.usage: Letter and percentile bar for grades A+ to A-. The letter itself carries the meaning; the colour only groups. 6.4:1+ on surface and on its tint.

tokens.name: grade-a-tint
tokens.usage: Filled grade badge background (A+ to A-): newsletter report cards.

tokens.name: grade-b
tokens.usage: Letter and percentile bar for grades B+ to B-. The letter itself carries the meaning; the colour only groups. 6.4:1+ on surface and on its tint.

tokens.name: grade-b-tint
tokens.usage: Filled grade badge background (B+ to B-): newsletter report cards.

tokens.name: grade-c
tokens.usage: Letter and percentile bar for grades C+ to C-. The letter itself carries the meaning; the colour only groups. 6.4:1+ on surface and on its tint.

tokens.name: grade-c-tint
tokens.usage: Filled grade badge background (C+ to C-): newsletter report cards.

tokens.name: grade-d
tokens.usage: Letter and percentile bar for grades D and below. The letter itself carries the meaning; the colour only groups. 6.4:1+ on surface and on its tint.

tokens.name: grade-d-tint
tokens.usage: Filled grade badge background (D and below): newsletter report cards.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Heat grid, lowest bucket (0–2 of 10). Text on it: ink-strong.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Heat grid, 3–4 of 10. Text on it: ink-strong (7:1).

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Heat grid, 5–6 of 10. Text on it: white (7.6:1).

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Heat grid, 7+ of 10. Text on it: white.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The newsletter headline. One per issue.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Player name on the card; matchup scores in the matchup header.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: KPI tile values; team name on the team page; POT.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Win % on matchup cards; grade letters; final scores.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Rank numbers, banked points, small tile values (17–20px range collapses here), newsletter section numbers.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: He was right. The Cannons covered the 48-point spread by Thursday.
styles.usage: Newsletter prose. Colour ink-body. Max ~38em per line on desktop.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, archetype label, team names in matchup rows (700).

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Player and team names in table rows and lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: On the block: Zach LaVine, Jerami Grant
styles.usage: Descriptions, trade-block text, numbers in table cells.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Section meta, chart captions, freshness line. ink-2 on canvas, ink-3 on surface.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Sub-lines under names, KPI context lines (700), chip text (800).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: KPI and column labels, uppercase. ink-3. The smallest text allowed; never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value inside a tile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Segmented-track padding and gaps; gap between bars.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a name and its sub-line; column gap in tables.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows; gap between small tiles.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; tile padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: KPI tile padding; header gaps.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen side padding on phone; header padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on Home; newsletter side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Newsletter section padding; desktop gutters.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Desktop section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Headshots: always square, no rounding.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Team swatches (10px squares), bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Heat-grid cells.

tokens.name: radius-9
tokens.usage: Segmented-control buttons; 36px monograms (monograms use 25% of their size).

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: KPI tiles, grade tiles, segmented track, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-14
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the Simple/Detailed toggle, the Compare button.

tokens.name: shadow-seg
tokens.usage: The selected segment in a segmented control. The only shadow in the system: cards use borders.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a tappable table or list row.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar including the home-indicator inset.

tokens.name: headshot-hero
tokens.usage: Square headshot on the player card.

tokens.name: headshot-feature
tokens.usage: Square headshot in the newsletter (Player of the Week).

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the newsletter column on desktop.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the hub on desktop.

tokens.name: bp-mid
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: from here, one column with wider cards and 4 KPI tiles across (README 'Breakpoints'). Added in 4b: media queries cannot read var(), so the renderer fills it in at build time.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: from here, two columns up to page-max and the tab bar becomes a top bar (README 'Breakpoints'). Added in 4b.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Border width of cards, bars and dividers (bundle.css uses 1px). Added in 4b so the renderer's own CSS has no px literal.

tokens.name: mono-72
tokens.usage: TeamMark on the team page (README 'Team pictures', TeamMark sizes). Added in 4b.

tokens.name: mono-36
tokens.usage: TeamMark in the matchup header. Added in 4b.

tokens.name: mono-28
tokens.usage: TeamMark in ranking rows. Added in 4b.

tokens.name: headshot-compare
tokens.usage: Square headshot on the Compare screen (page-map 'Players', Compare). Added in 4c1.

tokens.name: ring-compare
tokens.usage: The OVR ring on the Compare screen (the player card's is 80px, components/bundle.css .lh-ring). Added in 4c1.
